title: Netflix Launches Netflix Is a Joke (NIAJ) Studios
summary: Netflix Is a Joke (NIAJ) Studios has forged a creative partnership with Nikki Glaser to develop her own original scripted series to star in and she will also star in.
body_markdown:
#


Forges Creative Partnership with Nikki Glaser as First Talent From the New Comedy Studio


##


Four-Time Emmy


®


-Nominated Comedian to Develop Original Scripted Series and Star in Two Comedy Specials Exclusively For Netflix


-


Netflix today announced the launch of Netflix Is a Joke (NIAJ) Studios, an in-house incubator and production studio designed to take a holistic approach to comedy talent across multiple formats. NIAJ Studios will develop projects with stand-up talent beyond the stage, crafting scripted comedies and original formats alongside both established stars and emerging voices in the comedy community.


-


As part of the announcement, Netflix has forged a new creative partnership with acclaimed Golden Globe®, two-time Grammy®, four-time Emmy® -nominated and WGA-award-winning comedian, writer, and actress Nikki Glaser as the first talent to join forces with the newly formed NIAJ Studios.


-


Under the new agreement, Glaser will develop her own original scripted series to star in and she will also star in and executive produce two stand-up comedy specials exclusively for Netflix.


-


Gloria Sanchez Productions has also signed on to executive produce Glaser’s first scripted series development.


-


Quote from Tracey Pakosta, Netflix VP Comedy Series: “


Great comedy starts with an unmistakable voice, and few comedians have one as fully formed as Nikki Glaser’s. She’s fearless, funny and disarmingly real, which makes her the ideal first partner for the NIAJ Studios vision. We can't wait to see the world she’ll build.”


-


Quote from Robbie Praw, VP, Netflix Standup and Comedy Formats: “


I


first met Nikki Glaser in a small comedy club 20 years ago and have had a front-row seat to her rise ever since. When Netflix’s


The Roast of Tom Brady


sent her career into overdrive in 2024, we watched audiences embrace what many of us have seen for years. She’s one of the sharpest comedic minds working today, with instincts to build something lasting well beyond stand-up. Netflix Is a Joke has always celebrated comedy in all its forms, and NIAJ Studios is the next step in our commitment to this community. We’re honored to be in Nikki’s corner as she builds what’s next.”


-


Quote from Nikki Glaser:


“Netflix gave me some of my earliest and biggest opportunities in comedy, so I couldn’t be more excited to begin this next phase of my career with them.”


Credit: Art Streiber


-


Headshots


[here](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/8d4edb32-7b89-4456-be28-51c6565f6d69) : (please download files, do not post link publicly)


-


Since her first Netflix special in 2019,


Nikki Glaser: Bangin',


Nikki has remained a cornerstone of the Netflix comedy family, featured in major festival lineups during the 2024 and 2026 Netflix Is a Joke festivals. From her breakout moment as a fan-favorite comic in


The Roast of Tom Brady


to serving as a judge for


The Roast of Marshawn Lynch


on


Funny AF with Kevin Hart


, Glaser has continuously expanded her collaboration with Netflix. She will next be heard voicing Priscilla in the upcoming Netflix animated film


Steps


, premiering November 20, and starring in the Eva Longoria directed Netflix comedy


THE FIFTH WHEEL,


premiering 2027.


-


Netflix Is a Joke (NIAJ)


is Netflix’s flagship comedy brand and platform, home to stand-up specials, the biennial Netflix Is a Joke Fest in Los Angeles, a YouTube channel, and a SiriusXM radio channel. The brand celebrates the full range of comedy, from legends to rising voices, and extends to documentary films on comedy icons, including


Who Is Martin Mull?


,


Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald


,


Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story


, and


SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of


. Follow @NetflixIsAJoke and visit NetflixIsAJokeFest.com for more.


-


Netflix remains the premier destination for top comedy creators, offering talent the freedom to build impactful projects across multiple formats. Stand-up stars like Nick Kroll, Shane Gillis, Bert Kreischer, and Leanne Morgan have segued from stand-up specials into starring in their own scripted series — including


Tires


,


Free Bert


,


Leanne


, and Kroll’s upcoming series


A Hundred Percent


. John Mulaney expanded from stand-up into live variety with


Everybody’s in LA


. That same creative environment attracts celebrated storytellers across the industry, driving hit series like


The Four Seasons


,


Nobody Wants This


,


Emily in Paris


,


Running Point


,


A Man on the Inside


, and


Haunted Hotel


, as well as upcoming titles


I Suck at Girls


,


Uncorked


, and


All the Rage


.


-


Women have been at the center of Netflix comedy for years. Ali Wong’s


Baby Cobra


and Hannah Gadsby’s


Nanette


became cultural moments, and Wanda Sykes and Michelle Buteau have built lasting careers with Netflix that stretch from stand-up to their own series. That commitment continues today, with women leading some of Netflix’s biggest comedies.


Nobody Wants This


, from creator Erin Foster and showrunner Jenni Konner, delivered the biggest opening week for a returning scripted comedy series this year with its third season.


The Four Seasons


, from Tina Fey, Lang Fisher and Tracey Wigfield, and


Running Point


, co-created by Mindy Kaling and starring Kate Hudson, both earned early Season 3 renewals, while Felicia Pride’s breakout


A Different World


was renewed for a second season. In stand-up, Wanda Sykes, who also starred in


The Upshaws


, and Taylor Tomlinson each debuted their fourth Netflix specials this year. Zainab Johnson debuted her first special last month, and Janelle James followed with her first hour-long special on November 10. Leanne Morgan has moved from specials to her own series,


Leanne


, now in its second season.
